problems.title: Single Number
problems.keyInsight: XOR all numbers. Pairs cancel out (a^a=0), leaving the single number.

code.python:
def hammingWeight(n):
    count = 0
    while n:
        count += n & 1
        n >>= 1
    return count
# Or: n & (n-1) drops lowest set bit

problems.title: Sum of Two Integers
problems.keyInsight: XOR = sum without carry. AND << 1 = carry. Repeat until no carry.

code.python:
def getSum(a, b):
    mask = 0xFFFFFFFF
    while b & mask:
        carry = (a & b) << 1
        a = a ^ b
        b = carry
    return a & mask if b > mask else a

def reverse(x):
    sign = 1 if x >= 0 else -1
    x = abs(x)
    result = 0
    while x:
        result = result * 10 + x % 10
        x //= 10
    result *= sign
    return result if -2**31 <= result <= 2**31-1 else 0
